seasonseries.title: LA Galaxy vs. San Diego FC

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! LA Galaxy 1, San Diego 0. João Klauss (LA Galaxy) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sergi Roberto following a fast break.
Goal! LA Galaxy 1, San Diego 1. Anders Dreyer (San Diego) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the top left corner.
Goal! LA Galaxy 2, San Diego 1. Erik Thommy (LA Galaxy) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Harbor Tarczynski-Miller with a cross.
Aníbal Godoy (San Diego) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! LA Galaxy 2, San Diego 2. Gabriel Pirani (San Diego) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
João Klauss (LA Galaxy) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, LA Galaxy 2, San Diego 2.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Joseph Paintsil replaces Robert Taylor.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Jakob Glesnes replaces Emiro Garcés.
Substitution, San Diego. Jeppe Tverskov replaces Alejandro Alvarado.
